name: block-no-verify
description: Recommend and install an approval-gated Codex hook that blocks Git verification and signing bypasses.

interface.shortDescription: Install a Git bypass-blocking hook with approval.
interface.longDescription: A Codex skill that recommends and, only after explicit approval, installs and tests a project- or user-scoped PreToolUse policy for Git --no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, and falsy commit.gpgsign bypasses. Installing this plugin enables the skill only; it does not activate a hook.
capabilities: Git verification and signing bypass detection
Codex hook trust and rollback guidance
defaultPrompt: Use $block-no-verify to assess whether this Git workflow should install the no-verify protection.
Use $block-no-verify to install and test the approved project-scoped Git bypass policy.
